title: Herbaceous
summary: Soft herbs (basil, cilantro) at the end; hardy herbs (rosemary, thyme) early in cooking.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — herbaceous is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: fresh_herb, olive_oil, acid. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Salt and acid make herbs pop; too much heat kills delicate aroma.
